repos.name: melgarafael/DeskcommCRM
repos.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
repos.one_liner: An open-source AI-native sales CRM designed for chat-based business workflows.
bullets: Built with TypeScript, featuring native AI agent integration and WhatsApp (WAHA) connectivity.
Serves as an open-source alternative to Intercom and Kommo for chat-centric sales teams.
Supports multi-tenant architecture and is fully MCP-ready for extensible agentic workflows.
Focuses on compliance and data sovereignty with self-hosted deployment options.

repos.name: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
repos.description: Run parallel research agents with any model
repos.one_liner: A framework for orchestrating parallel research agents using arbitrary LLM backends.
bullets: Written in Rust to ensure high-performance execution of concurrent agentic tasks.
Designed to automate complex research workflows by distributing queries across multiple AI models.
Enables scalable literature review and data synthesis for academic or technical research.
Provides a modular architecture for integrating custom research tools and data sources.

repos.name: dataelement/dsh-desktop
repos.one_liner: A dedicated desktop interface for interacting with DeepSeek models.
bullets: TypeScript-based desktop application providing a streamlined UI for DeepSeek Harness.
Facilitates local or remote interaction with high-performance LLMs for development tasks.
Optimizes the developer experience for prompt engineering and model testing.
Acts as a critical infrastructure tool for teams integrating DeepSeek into their AI stack.

repos.name: openaiotlab/CUHK-X
repos.description: [MobiSys 2026] A large-scale, multimodal dataset and benchmark for Human Action Recognition, Understanding and Reasoning
repos.one_liner: A large-scale multimodal benchmark dataset for human action recognition and reasoning.
bullets: Python-based framework for evaluating multimodal AI models on complex human action tasks.
Provides a standardized benchmark for training agents that require visual and behavioral understanding.
Essential for research in robotics, surveillance, and advanced computer vision applications.
Supports the development of more robust AI agents capable of real-world physical reasoning.

repos.name: jiji262/douyin-downloader
repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。
repos.one_liner: A robust Python-based utility for batch downloading and managing multimedia content.
bullets: Utilizes Python with SQLite for efficient deduplication and metadata management.
Features browser fallback support and retry logic to ensure high success rates in data scraping.
Useful for financial or market analysts needing to aggregate large volumes of social media video data.
Supports batch processing of profiles, collections, and individual media assets.
